texts.value: Component of a complex required to localize phosphatidylinositol 4-kinase (PI4K) to the plasma membrane (PubMed:23229899, PubMed:25608530, PubMed:26571211). The complex acts as a regulator of phosphatidylinositol 4-phosphate (PtdIns(4)P) synthesis (Probable). In the complex, EFR3A probably acts as the membrane-anchoring component (PubMed:23229899). Also involved in responsiveness to G protein-coupled receptors; it is however unclear whether this role is direct or indirect (PubMed:25380825)
Component of a phosphatidylinositol 4-kinase (PI4K) complex, composed of PI4KA, EFR3 (EFR3A or EFR3B), TTC7 (TTC7A or TTC7B) and HYCC (HYCC1 or HYCC2) (PubMed:26571211)
Palmitoylation anchors the protein to the plasma membrane (PubMed:23229899, PubMed:25380825, PubMed:26571211). A small amount is observed in the cytosol (PubMed:25380825)
Palmitoylated at its N-terminus, anchoring the protein to the plasma membrane
Genetic variations in EFR3A may be associated with susceptibility to autism
